title: Jeep Wagoneer & Grand Wagoneer (WS)
verdict: Jeep spent a decade promising to bring back the Grand Wagoneer, then built a 6,000-pound, three-row, air-sprung luxury barge that took four years to remember it was a Jeep. It tows 10,000 pounds and will happily do a fire road, but it isn't the woody you're thinking of, and nobody at Jeep claims it's a rock crawler.

paragraphs: The WS is Jeep's full-size, body-on-frame, three-row SUV, revealed on March 11, 2021 as the 2022 Wagoneer and Grand Wagoneer and built at Warren Truck Assembly in Michigan. It borrows two of the most loved names in the family, from the [[jeep/sj-wagoneer|SJ Wagoneer]] of 1963 and [[jeep/grand-wagoneer|the original Grand Wagoneer]], and aims them at the Chevrolet Tahoe, the Cadillac Escalade and the [[range-rover/l460|Range Rover]]. It launched with Hemi V8s, switched to a twin-turbo straight six, and spent its first five years arguing with itself about whether it was even a Jeep.

story.heading: TEN YEARS OF 'SOON' (2011–2021)
paragraphs: Sergio Marchionne promised a new Grand Wagoneer at the Detroit show in January 2011, then planned on a Grand Cherokee and Durango platform. The project slipped repeatedly: a 2013 delay, a dealer preview promised for August 2015, teaser photos in October 2016 pointing at a 2019 model, and another delay in March 2017. In 2017 FCA committed $1 billion to retool Warren Truck for it, a figure that later rose to $1.5 billion. Spy photographers caught a Ram 1500-based test mule in December 2019, and COVID pushed production back again.

Jeep showed the Grand Wagoneer Concept on September 3, 2020, with no Jeep badge anywhere on it, and revealed the production trucks on March 11, 2021. Stellantis described them as a 'premium extension of the Jeep brand', with Wagoneer-certified dealers, a client-service concierge and ten written promises to every owner. Wagoneer and Grand Wagoneer shared one body on a new frame that MotorTrend says is loosely based on the Ram 1500 (DT), but different enough that almost nothing is shared, and 2 inches wider than the Ram. They are built on the same Warren line as the Ram 1500 Classic.

story.heading: TWO NAMES, ONE TRUCK, NO BADGE
paragraphs: Here is the part that confused everyone. The Wagoneer and the Grand Wagoneer are the same size. The Wagoneer (Series I, II, III and Carbide) was the mainstream model aimed at the Tahoe. The Grand Wagoneer (Series I, II, III and Obsidian) was the luxury version aimed at the Escalade and Navigator, with a two-tone black roof, fender flares, power side steps, bigger screens and, at launch, a CNBC-reported top price above $111,000. For 2023 Jeep added the Wagoneer L and Grand Wagoneer L, a foot longer on a 130-inch wheelbase. MotorTrend says buyers thought the Grand Wagoneer was a stretched Wagoneer. It wasn't: 'Grand' meant pricier, not bigger.

The branding didn't help. Wikipedia describes the launch branding as 'Wagoneer by Jeep', and the trucks wore Wagoneer badges with no Jeep logo. On February 29, 2024, Jalopnik reported that Jeep CEO Antonio Filosa had said Wagoneer would stop being a sub-brand once the electric Wagoneer S launched, and that future Wagoneers would wear Jeep badges. On October 14, 2025, Jeep revealed the facelifted 2026 Grand Wagoneer: the standalone Wagoneer nameplate was dropped, every truck became a Grand Wagoneer, Jeep badges went on front and rear, the Series trim names were replaced, and pricing started at $64,740. MotorTrend's headline that day was blunt: 'The Jeep Wagoneer Is Dead'.

story.heading: FROM HEMI TO HURRICANE
paragraphs: The 2022 Wagoneer used the 5.7-liter Hemi V8 with Stellantis's 48-volt eTorque mild-hybrid system, rated at 392 hp and 404 lb-ft on a 3.21 axle ratio. The 2022 Grand Wagoneer got the 6.4-liter Hemi with 471 hp and 455 lb-ft on a 3.92 axle. Both drove through an eight-speed ZF-designed 8HP75 automatic. For 2023 the 3.0-liter Hurricane twin-turbo straight six arrived in the L models: 420 hp and 468 lb-ft in standard-output form, or 510 hp and 500 lb-ft as the high-output engine in the Grand Wagoneer. It was also offered as an option above the 5.7 in the regular Wagoneer.

For 2024 the V8s were dropped and every WS got a Hurricane. Jeep kept the 10,000-pound tow rating and said the six was up to 15 percent more efficient than the V8 it replaced. The high-output engine went up to 540 hp and 521 lb-ft for 2025. For 2026 only the 420-hp standard-output engine is offered, and the high-output version is on hold while Jeep readies a range-extended plug-in hybrid with a 92-kWh battery. Asked about a Hemi comeback, Jeep chief Bob Broderdorf told MotorTrend 'no announcements at this time'.

story.heading: HOW BOXY, HOW OFF-ROAD, HONESTLY
paragraphs: Boxy, yes, in the way a filing cabinet is boxy: slab sides, an upright tailgate and a seven-slot grille stretched across 214.7 inches of body, or 226.7 inches for an L. Car and Driver says the 2026 facelift made the design squarer still, with the headlights set higher. But this is a fully independent family hauler, not a solid-axle truck. It has short- and long-arm front suspension with aluminum lower arms and a five-link independent rear on coil springs or Quadra-Lift air springs. The [[jeep/sj-wagoneer|SJ]]'s leaf springs and Dana 44 front axle are a world away.

Jeep never gave it a Trail Rated badge. The best setup is the Advanced All-Terrain Group, which adds a two-speed transfer case (2.64:1 low), a 3.92 axle, a rear electronic limited-slip differential, 18-inch all-terrain tires, skid plates, tow hooks and a 48:1 crawl ratio. With the air suspension in Off-Road 2 it has 10 inches of clearance, 25/24/22-degree approach, departure and breakover angles, and 24 inches of wading depth. MotorTrend ran an Advanced All-Terrain Wagoneer for 20,672 miles. Its verdict: keep it to dirt and fire roads, because the belly is too low and the flanks too exposed for anything harder, even at full height. The Grand Wagoneer is better at reaching a trailhead with a 10,000-pound camper than at driving the trail itself.

callout.label: SIDEBAR · THE CONCIERGE ERA
callout.title: Wagoneer Client Service, ten promises and the vanishing ambassadors
paragraphs: To justify Escalade money, the 2021 launch promised a buying and ownership experience separate from the Jeep showroom. Wagoneer-certified dealers would have a dedicated display and delivery area and specially trained 'Wagoneer Ambassadors'. The brand made ten promises to every owner and offered a Client Service concierge, and Stellantis's launch release listed five years of dealer maintenance, including oil changes and tire rotations.

Within three years the plan was being wound down. When Jalopnik called four 'Wagoneer Certified' dealers in Southern California in 2024, one salesman said he wasn't familiar with the program. A Jeep vice president told the outlet that the premium experience would continue under the Jeep badge.

engineering_intro: The WS has a separate, fully boxed high-strength-steel ladder frame with crossmembers welded inside and out, aluminum hood and doors, a composite liftgate and about 6,500 welds in the body. MotorTrend says it is loosely related to the Ram 1500 (DT) but shares almost nothing with it, and MotorTrend's 2026 coverage calls the platform STLA Frame. Suspension is independent at all four corners, on coils or four-corner air springs with semi-active damping. Power goes through a ZF-designed 8HP75 eight-speed automatic to one of three Quadra-Trac or Quadra-Drive systems. Rear-wheel drive was offered on the Wagoneer, while four-wheel drive was standard on the Grand Wagoneer.

engineering.v: Body-on-frame, fully boxed rails, 123.0 in / 130.0 in (L) wheelbase
engineering.note: Loosely Ram 1500 (DT)-based but 2 in wider, with almost nothing shared, per MotorTrend. Frame-mounted steel blockers behind the front tires help in small-overlap crashes.

Aluminum front lower arms and knuckles, cast-aluminum rear links. Steel coils with monotube shocks as standard, Quadra-Lift air springs with semi-active damping optional on Wagoneer and standard on Grand Wagoneer.
Park −1.6 in, Aero −0.6 in, normal 8.0 in, Off-Road 1 9.0 in, Off-Road 2 10.0 in of ground clearance. Closed-loop system with an external valve block and a secondary reservoir.

engineering.v: Quadra-Trac I · Quadra-Trac II · Quadra-Drive II
engineering.note: QT I is full-time and single-speed, with no low range. QT II and QD II have a two-speed transfer case with 2.64:1 low. QD II adds a rear electronic limited-slip diff. Selec-Terrain has Auto, Sport, Rock, Snow and Sand/Mud modes.

engineering.v: 5.7 Hemi eTorque V8 · 6.4 Hemi V8 · 3.0 Hurricane twin-turbo I6
engineering.note: 392 / 471 hp for the V8s (2022–23). The Hurricane makes 420 hp in standard-output form and 510 hp (2023–24) or 540 hp (2025) in high-output form. 2026 is standard-output only.
Approach, departure and breakover angles are at maximum air height. The Advanced All-Terrain Group gives a 48:1 crawl ratio.

generations_table.note: 3.21 axle. Coils standard, air optional. RWD or 4x4. Hurricane optional for 2023.
3.92 axle, Quadra-Drive II and air suspension standard. Series I–III and Obsidian.
L is 12 in longer on a 130 in wheelbase. Hurricane-only from 2024.
The V8 was dropped for 2024. Series I–III and Obsidian trims.
The last year of the separate Wagoneer nameplate.
One name, Jeep badges, no chrome. New Upland off-road trim (short wheelbase only). Range-extended PHEV announced.

buying_checks.head: Run the VIN for recalls first
buying_checks.body: NHTSA lists more than a dozen WS campaigns. Many are rear-camera software fixes (23V-577, 24V-436, 24V-944, 26V-326, 26V-531). There's also an airbag-control software fix (21V-873), a B-pillar trim that can foul the curtain airbag (23V-545), third-row belt buckles (23V-716), door and window trim that can fall off (25V-593, 25V-642), roof-rack crossbar pivot bolts (26V-584) and TPMS software (26V-559). Make sure each one is closed.

buying_checks.head: Cycle the air suspension through every height
buying_checks.body: On an air-sprung truck, run it from Park to Off-Road 2 and back with the engine idling, and look for a 'Service Air Suspension' message. Early 2022 trucks built on or before February 15, 2022 are covered by TSB 02-001-22: unseated air lines, an unplugged control module, disconnected height sensors and even red shipping caps left on the compressor vent hose.

buying_checks.head: Ask whether the software is current
buying_checks.body: This truck runs on software. Bulletins cover blank or frozen 10.1- and 12-inch center screens (radio update TSB 08-039-22), power-steering module flashes (08-202-22) and telematics resets (08-173-21). MotorTrend's long-term Wagoneer was updated at every dealer service. Check the screens, cameras, remote start and app connection before you sign.

buying_checks.head: 2022 5.7 eTorque: test low-speed stop-start
buying_checks.body: In 2024 NHTSA opened a probe into reports of 2022 Ram 1500s and Wagoneers losing power, with the engine shutting off at low speed. On a test drive, do several stops and restarts in traffic and note any warning lights. Ask whether any dealer work was done on the eTorque system or the 48 V battery, which sits under the cabin floor.

buying_checks.head: Know which 4x4 system it has
buying_checks.body: Quadra-Trac I is single-speed, with no low range. For trails, look for Quadra-Trac II or Quadra-Drive II with the 2.64:1 low range. Best of all is the Advanced All-Terrain Group, with a 3.92 axle, rear electronic LSD, 18-inch all-terrain tires, skid plates and tow hooks. A rear-drive Wagoneer is a different vehicle altogether.

buying_checks.head: Check the oil in the service records
buying_checks.body: The standard-output Hurricane specifies 0W-20, while the high-output Hurricane in Grand Wagoneers specifies 0W-40 (MS-A0921). A Grand Wagoneer serviced with the wrong oil by a quick-lube shop is a reason to ask more questions. The 6.4 also uses 0W-40, and the 5.7 uses 0W-20.

buying_checks.head: If you'll tow, look for the right package
buying_checks.body: The 10,000-lb rating applies to properly equipped Wagoneers. The Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow package adds the trailer brake controller, hitch zoom and heavy-duty cooling. MotorTrend found the hitch sat oddly high, so they needed a big drop hitch, and the air suspension kept adjusting ride height with a trailer attached.

buying_checks.head: Price it against a new one
buying_checks.body: A new 2026 Grand Wagoneer starts at $64,740, so check new-truck pricing and incentives before paying close to that for a used one. Bring a Trailer has sold only one WS so far: a 2025 Grand Wagoneer L Series III for $78,500 in January 2026.

repairs.title: Diagnose a 'Service Air Suspension' warning
repairs.cost: Covered by TSB 02-001-22 on affected 2022 trucks; parts plus labor otherwise
repairs.symptoms: 'Service Air Suspension' in the cluster, the truck stuck at one height, or air ride not working front and rear. On early 2022 trucks the code C15AE-00 (compressor pressure line leak) is common.
repairs.fix: Start with what FCA's TSB checks. Put the truck in Tire Jack mode from the radio's Suspension menu before you lift it. Remove the front inner wheel liners. Check that the air suspension control module connector is fully seated and the compressor vent hose is connected with no red shipping caps left on it. Confirm that each air line goes into its spring up to the tape mark, within 1 mm. Check that the front and rear ride-height sensors are plugged in and their linkage rods are attached. Deflating the springs and clearing codes needs a scan tool with air-suspension functions (the dealer uses wiTECH). Leaks after that call for soapy water on the lines and the valve block.
repairs.tools: Scan tool with ASCM functions · lift or jack stands · trim-clip tools for the wheel liners · soapy water spray

repairs.title: Change the oil and filter (Hemi or Hurricane)
repairs.cost: MotorTrend paid $156.79 and $173.90 for dealer 10k and 20k services, including a tire rotation
repairs.symptoms: The oil-life monitor is due, or the history is unknown.
repairs.fix: Warm the engine, lift the truck safely and drain the oil. AMSOIL lists drain-plug torque at 20 ft-lb on the 3.0 Hurricane and 25 ft-lb on the 6.4. Fit the correct filter: AMSOIL lists WIX WL10255 for the standard-output 3.0, WIX 57045 for the high-output 3.0 and WIX 57060 for the 5.7 and 6.4. Refill with the correct grade: 0W-20 (MS-6395) for the 5.7 and the standard-output 3.0, or 0W-40 (MS-A0921) for the 6.4 and the high-output 3.0. Capacity is 7 qt for the V8s and 7.5 qt for the Hurricane. Check the level, then reset the oil-life monitor.
repairs.tools: Socket for the drain plug · filter wrench · torque wrench · drain pan · jack stands or ramps

repairs.title: Service the front and rear differentials
repairs.cost: Parts only: about 5–6 pints of synthetic 75W-85
repairs.symptoms: Unknown history, a deep water crossing, or towing. You may hear whine or chatter in tight turns from the electronic LSD.
repairs.fix: Both axles take synthetic 75W-85 GL-5. AMSOIL lists the 215FD front at 2.3 pints and the 260RDU rear at 3 pints on Hurricane and 6.4 trucks (its 2022 5.7 entry shows 2.3 pints without ELSD and 2.7 with). Remove the fill plug first so you know you can refill, then drain, refit the drain plug and fill to the bottom of the fill hole. AMSOIL's lookups cite Mopar 75W-85 with modifier (P/N 68083381AA) for the rear axle, but its entries disagree on whether the ELSD or the open axle needs it, so confirm the fluid in your manual or with the dealer.
repairs.tools: Fluid pump · sockets or hex bits for the plugs · drain pan · torque wrench

parts.name: Mopar 68083381AA gear and axle lubricant with modifier

repairs.title: 8HP75 automatic: fluid and pan service
repairs.cost: Parts plus a scan tool, or a shop job
repairs.symptoms: High mileage, heavy towing or an unknown history. Harsh or slurred shifts are the warning sign.
repairs.fix: The 8HP75 takes SL076-spec ATF, and AMSOIL lists 9 to 9.5 qt total fill. A pan drop changes only part of that. Drain, replace the pan and gasket as RockAuto lists them for these trucks, then fill and check the level by the service manual's procedure. That procedure depends on fluid temperature, so you need a scan tool to read it. Overfilling or underfilling a ZF eight-speed causes more problems than it fixes. If the truck is under warranty, have the dealer do it.
repairs.tools: Scan tool that reads transmission temperature · fluid pump · torque wrench · drain pan · lift

repairs.title: Front and rear brake pads and rotors
repairs.symptoms: Pulsing under braking, squeal, or a pad-wear warning. A 6,000-plus-lb SUV that tows is hard on brakes.
repairs.fix: These trucks have a switch-operated electric parking brake. Before you work on the rear calipers, put it in service mode with a scan tool or by the owner's-manual method so the motors retract. Pull the calipers, replace the pads and rotors, clean and grease the slide pins, torque everything to spec and bed the pads in. Flush the DOT 3 fluid at the same time if the history is unknown.
repairs.tools: Scan tool for the electric park brake · caliper piston tool · torque wrench · brake cleaner

repairs.title: Blank screens and glitches: updates and the battery
repairs.cost: Free under warranty; a battery if it's weak
repairs.symptoms: A blank or unresponsive 10.1- or 12-inch center screen, a rear camera that doesn't show, Wi-Fi or remote functions dead, or warning messages after a short drive.
repairs.fix: Check the battery first, because low voltage causes all kinds of module faults. Test it, then clean and tighten the terminals. Next, look for over-the-air radio updates in Uconnect settings. FCA also has a bulletin on how to install them. Bulletins for dealer flashes include TSB 08-039-22 for blank center screens, which FCA says must be done before the display is replaced, plus 08-202-22 for the power-steering module and 08-173-21 for the telematics box. Several camera faults are recalls rather than TSBs, so run the VIN.
repairs.tools: Battery tester · terminal brush · a USB drive if an update calls for one

repairs.title: Engine air filter and Hurricane spark plugs
repairs.symptoms: Dusty-road use, a misfire code or an unknown history.
repairs.fix: The air filter is a tool-free job: unclip the airbox, swap the element and wipe out the housing. On the Hurricane, take off the engine cover and the coils to reach the plugs, blow debris out of the wells before removing each plug, and torque the new plugs to the service-manual figure. We couldn't confirm the factory plug interval, so check your maintenance schedule.
repairs.tools: Plug socket with extension · torque wrench · compressed air · dielectric grease

baseline_service.intro: A WS is new enough that most are still under factory or extended warranty, so get every recall and software flash done at the dealer first. Then baseline the fluids most owners skip: both axles, the transfer case, the transmission and brake fluid. Specs differ by engine. The standard-output Hurricane, the high-output Hurricane and the two Hemis use different oils and filters. Capacities below are from AMSOIL's application lookups. Confirm against your owner's manual.

items.interval: Baseline now; then per the oil-life monitor
items.note: Filters per AMSOIL: WIX 57060 (5.7 and 6.4), WL10255 (3.0 SO), 57045 (3.0 HO). Drain-plug torque 20 ft-lb (3.0) or 25 ft-lb (6.4).

items.interval: Baseline now; check after dusty trips

items.note: Location and part number not confirmed; check the owner's manual.

items.spec: Hurricane I6: 6 plugs · Hemi V8: 16 plugs
items.interval: Per the maintenance schedule [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]
items.note: Hemis use two plugs per cylinder.

items.spec: 5.7: 16.9 qt · 6.4: 18.8 qt · 3.0: 16.6 qt engine plus 3.2 qt intercooler circuit · type [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]
items.note: The Hurricane has a separate intercooler coolant circuit (3.2 qt), so check it too.

items.interval: Baseline if towing or unknown history; dealer or a shop with a scan tool
items.note: The level check depends on temperature. A pan drop replaces only part of the fluid.

items.interval: Baseline now if it has low range and has been used off-road or for towing
items.note: AMSOIL lists no fluid for it. Quadra-Trac I (single-speed), Quadra-Trac II and Quadra-Drive II use different cases.

items.interval: Baseline now; again after deep water

items.spec: 75W-85 GL-5 synthetic · 3 pt (AMSOIL lists 2.3–2.7 pt for the 2022 5.7)
items.interval: Baseline now; more often when towing
items.note: AMSOIL cites Mopar 75W-85 with modifier, P/N 68083381AA, but its entries disagree on which rear axle (ELSD or open) needs it. [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]

parts.name: Mopar 68083381AA gear and axle lubricant with modifier

items.interval: Flush now; then per schedule [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]
items.note: Electric park brake: use service mode before you touch the rear calipers.

items.spec: Cycle Park → Off-Road 2; listen for the compressor; scan for codes
items.note: On early 2022 trucks, check TSB 02-001-22 items: air lines seated to the tape mark, control-module plug, vent hose and height-sensor links.

items.spec: Load-test the 12 V battery; check the eTorque system on 5.7 trucks
items.note: Low voltage causes many WS electronic faults. The 5.7's 48 V pack mounts to the cabin floor.

items.spec: Inspect the boots and joints; check for play
items.interval: Now and after every rough-road trip
items.note: The fully independent front and rear use CV axles, so a torn boot fills with grit fast.

faq.q: What's the biggest tire I can fit without a lift?
faq.a: We couldn't find an owner consensus we trust yet, so we won't guess. Factory sizes are 275/65R18 all-terrains with the Advanced All-Terrain Group, 275/55R20 and 285/45R22, on a 6x139.7 bolt pattern. Limitless Tire's fitment guide lists 275–305 mm widths on 18- to 26-inch wheels. Test-fit anything taller at full lock in Off-Road 2 and at Park height, because the air suspension drops the body 1.6 inches. Running bigger tires on yours? Tell us.

faq.q: What's the difference between a Wagoneer and a Grand Wagoneer?
faq.a: Price and equipment, not size. Both share the same body and wheelbase. Through 2025 the Grand Wagoneer added standard air suspension, Quadra-Drive II, a two-tone roof, fender flares, power side steps, bigger screens and the bigger engine (6.4 Hemi, then the high-output Hurricane). The long 'L' versions of each are 12 inches longer. From 2026 every truck is called Grand Wagoneer.

faq.q: Is it actually any good off-road?
faq.a: Good for its size, but it isn't a Wrangler. It isn't Trail Rated. With the Advanced All-Terrain Group it has low range, a rear electronic LSD, skid plates, 10 inches of clearance and a 48:1 crawl ratio. MotorTrend's 20,000-mile test truck was happiest on dirt and fire roads. Its belly sat too low and its flanks were too exposed for harder trails, even at maximum height.

faq.q: Does it have lockers or low range?
faq.a: There are no lockers. Quadra-Trac II and Quadra-Drive II have a two-speed transfer case with 2.64:1 low range. Quadra-Drive II adds a rear electronic limited-slip differential. Quadra-Trac I is single-speed with no low range, and rear-drive Wagoneers have no 4x4 at all.

faq.q: Which engine should I buy: Hemi or Hurricane?
faq.a: The 5.7 eTorque (2022–23 Wagoneer) and the 6.4 (2022–23 Grand Wagoneer) are familiar Hemis. The 3.0 Hurricane twin-turbo six makes more power and torque. Jeep said the 420-hp version is up to 15 percent more efficient than the V8, and MotorTrend loved its smoothness. The 2022 5.7 eTorque was part of a 2024 NHTSA probe into engines shutting off at low speed, so check its history.

Up to 10,000 lb for a properly equipped Wagoneer, which Jeep calls best in class. Motor1 reported a 9,860-lb rating for the 2023 Grand Wagoneer. Get the Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow package for the brake controller and extra cooling, and a deep drop hitch: MotorTrend found the receiver mounted high.

faq.q: What fuel economy does it get?
faq.a: MotorTrend's 2023 4x4 Wagoneer with the 420-hp Hurricane was rated 16 mpg city, 26 highway and 19 combined. Over 20,672 miles it averaged 16.4 mpg, and its best tank was 20.3 mpg.

It depends on the engine. The 5.7 and the standard-output 3.0 take 0W-20 meeting MS-6395. The 6.4 and the high-output 3.0 in Grand Wagoneers take 0W-40, with the HO Hurricane calling for MS-A0921. AMSOIL lists 7 qt with the filter for the V8s and 7.5 qt for the Hurricane.

faq.q: Why doesn't it have a Jeep badge?
faq.a: At launch in 2021, Wagoneer was sold as a premium extension of Jeep with its own badges, dealer program and concierge. In February 2024 Jeep said it would stop being a sub-brand and future Wagoneers would wear Jeep badges. The facelifted 2026 Grand Wagoneer, revealed October 14, 2025, has Jeep logos front and rear.

Coil-spring trucks can take Rough Country's 3-inch bolt-on kit (60800) for 2022–2025 4WD Wagoneers. It does not fit trucks with Quadra-Lift air suspension. Air-sprung trucks already lift themselves to 10 inches of clearance in Off-Road 2.

Too new for a long record. NHTSA lists more than a dozen recalls, mostly software, camera and trim fixes. Early 2022 trucks had an air-suspension assembly TSB. MotorTrend's long-termer needed only two routine services totalling $330.69 in 20,672 miles. Buy one with the recalls done and the warranty still running.

mods.why: Levels the factory rake and adds clearance on trucks without Quadra-Lift. Air-sprung trucks can't use it.

who.name: Rough Country 3 in lift kit 60800, 2022–2025 Wagoneer 4WD

mods.why: Highway tires on 20s and 22s are the weak link on gravel. The Advanced All-Terrain Group's 18-inch all-terrains are the size to copy.

who.name: Limitless Tire — Wagoneer wheel and tire fitment

mods.why: Smaller wheels mean more sidewall for airing down. The 6x139.7 pattern and 77.8 mm center bore are listed by fitment sites, but check brake clearance before you buy.

The Advanced All-Terrain Group added steel skid plates for the front suspension, transfer case, fuel tank and rear stabilizer, plus front tow hooks. They're the parts to look for on a used truck or to add from Mopar.
This is what the WS does best. Add the factory trailer brake controller if it's missing, and use a deep drop hitch because the receiver sits high.
